content.short: PingMe is a stablecoin payments app on Monad sending crypto by email, QR or message.
content.description: PingMe lets someone send stablecoins to a phone number or email address in place of a hex address, including to recipients who have never used crypto. The receiving side claims the funds into a wallet created for them, so the sender does not need the recipient onboarded first. The product runs on Monad.
content.meta: PingMe is a stablecoin payments app on Monad that sends funds to a phone number or email, even to people who have never used crypto.
